summary:
Archive-instead-of-hard-delete feature verified end-to-end. Backend: 9/9 pytest cases in /app/backend/tests/test_archive_dealers.py PASS — zero-sub DELETE→200 hard_delete:true (removed from both default and include_archived lists); DELETE with submissions→409 with EXACT message 'Dealer has N submission(s). Archive them instead to preserve billing history.' (dealer + all submissions preserved); POST /admin/dealers/{id}/archive→200 with {status:archived, archived_at:iso, submissions_preserved:3}, dealer hidden from default GET /admin/dealers, visible with archived_at!=null when include_archived=true, submissions count unchanged; archived dealer login→403 with 'archived' wording (no 'suspend' word); GET /admin/billing rows expose archived:bool + archived_at, archived row shows archived:true and amount_zar unchanged (historical R100 preserved); POST /restore→200 with {status:restored}, dealer re-appears active=true archived_at=null, login works; restore on non-archived→400; suspend still independent (active=false without archived_at, still visible in default list, login 403 with 'suspend' wording). Frontend mobile 390x844: dealers-toggle-archived button present (eye-off/Show archived when OFF, eye/Showing archived cyan when ON); header stats update to '4 registered · 4 active · 1 archived' when toggle ON with archived dealer present; archived dealer card renders ARCHIVED grey pill, Archived <date> meta, Restore button (dealer-restore-{id}) — Edit/Reset PW/toggle hidden (edit_btns=4 vs cards=5 with 1 archived); Billing screen renders ARCHIVED pill inline next to archived dealer's name; TOTAL DUE R150.00 unchanged after archive. Desktop 1440x900: cockpit-view-billing swaps to BillingScreen and shows ARCHIVED pill next to Test Dealer; cockpit-view-submissions returns to standard cockpit with admin-filter-incoming default and 3-way chips (incoming/priced/archived) present. Regressions verified: cyan theme intact, login+cockpit rendering unchanged.

**CRITICAL UI BUG FOUND** — React Native `Alert.alert` used in dealers.tsx (removeDealer + restoreDealer) does NOT render any confirmation dialog on react-native-web build. Tapping the archive/trash icon and the Restore button produces NO visible modal/window.confirm/inline overlay (verified: 0 dialogs captured, 0 role=dialog nodes, body text never contains 'Archive dealer' or 'Remove dealer' after click). Consequence: on the web preview (which the admin cockpit primarily runs on) admins **cannot** archive, remove, or restore dealers from the UI at all — the confirm callback never fires because there is no dialog to tap 'Archive'/'Remove'/'Restore' on. Backend API works, but the UI is unreachable. On native (Expo Go / real device) Alert.alert works, so the mobile dealer app itself is unaffected — but the desktop admin cockpit is broken for this flow. Recommend replacing Alert.alert with a cross-platform confirm (custom Modal or window.confirm fallback on web) — same pattern already used in dealers.tsx line 165 for password reset (`window.prompt` on web).

ui_bugs.issue: Alert.alert does not render a confirm dialog on react-native-web. Tapping remove-dealer-{id} or dealer-restore-{id} produces no modal, so admin on web can never confirm and the archive/remove/restore action never fires. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(app)/dealers.tsx:76-97 (Archive), :101-122 (Remove), :126-146 (Restore).

react_native_issues.issue: Alert.alert() on react-native-web is a silent no-op — no dialog, no console log with the prompt for the user. Dealers.tsx already handles this for password reset by falling back to window.prompt (line ~165). Same fallback needed for archive/remove/restore confirms (window.confirm) OR migrate to a cross-platform Modal component. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(app)/dealers.tsx:76,101,126,210.

rca_of_issue: React Native's Alert.alert on react-native-web is a silent no-op: it does not open a browser confirm(), does not add any DOM node, and (in the current bundle) does not even log to the console. Dealers.tsx relies on Alert.alert for the archive/remove/restore confirms — the actual /archive, /restore, DELETE API calls live in the Alert.alert onPress callback, which never fires because the user never sees a confirm button. Repro: log in as admin on the web preview, go to Dealers, tap the archive/trash icon on any dealer or the Restore button — nothing happens visually and no request is issued. Mitigation (matches existing dealers.tsx pattern at line 165 which already falls back to window.prompt on web for the password reset): wrap Alert.alert with a Platform.OS === 'web' branch that uses window.confirm(message) and awaits the boolean before dispatching the mutation. Alternatively, replace all three flows with a shared ConfirmModal component (works on both platforms).
